people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Surely as a wife treacherously departs from her husband, so you have dealt treacherously with me, house of Israel,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: But as a woman may betray her husband, so you have betrayed Me, O house of Israel,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: Surely as a wife treacherously departeth from her husband, so have ye dealt treacherously with me, O house of Israel, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: Surely as a wife treacherously departeth from her husband, so have ye dealt treacherously with me, O house of Israel, saith Jehovah.
